stories.title: NHS treatment waiting list rises for third month in a row in Wales
stories.summary: The number of NHS treatment waiting-list pathways in Wales has risen for the third month in a row. New figures released by the Welsh Government show that in June there were just under 698,400 referral to treatment (RTT) patient pathways waiting to start treatment, an increase of around 8,700 since May.
